name: Strateloq - Creative Image Executor
description: Launch-critical live CUSTOMER static-creative executor. Webhook {job_id, source_image_url, prompt, size}; downloads the authoritative Product Card image; normalizes its mimetype to an OpenAI-accepted type; runs the OpenAI gpt-image-1 product-preserving edit; returns the OpenAI JSON (b64 + usage) to the caller (the Supabase edge function creative-image-execute). Credential references only; no secret values.

nodes.name: Normalize Image Mimetype
nodes.notes: Relabel downloaded product image to an OpenAI-accepted mimetype. CJ CDN serves JPEG bytes as image/jpg, which /v1/images/edits rejects. Bytes unchanged; only metadata corrected.
